To Whom It May Concern,  

I’ve collaborated daily with Xin Zhao for over two years as part of AdVerve’s security team. As a skip-level manager in a mid-sized agency, I’ve observed his growth and contributions firsthand. Xin’s role as a Security Engineer—Threat Detection requires both technical rigor and collaborative problem-solving, areas where he consistently excels.  

Xin’s strength lies in his ability to balance proactive security frameworks with real-world adaptability. He’s deeply integrated OWASP guidelines into our application security workflow, ensuring vulnerabilities are identified early. His approach to monitoring and alerting is methodical—he once redesigned our SIEM dashboards to prioritize high-risk alerts, reducing false positives by over 40% without compromising detection thresholds. This attention to precision has strengthened our team’s response to emerging threats.  

A standout moment occurred during a recent breach attempt. Xin quickly isolated the compromised subnet using network segmentation protocols, preventing lateral movement. His calm under pressure and refusal to escalate without thorough analysis saved significant remediation time. Beyond technical skills, Xin’s collaborative spirit is notable—he regularly mentors junior engineers and shares insights on securing adtech infrastructure.  

Xin’s dedication to security as a collaborative effort, not a siloed function, makes him a valuable asset. I wholeheartedly recommend him for any opportunity where his expertise and work ethic can thrive.  

Sincerely,  
[Your Full Name]

AdVerve Technologies
